name: Demo Customers
expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS('Demo Customer 360'),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Accepted master cohort count; independent of demo date selection.

name: Demo Customers with Payroll
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[Has Salary Domiciliation] = TRUE()))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer snapshot rule count; no future prediction.

name: Demo Likely Primary Bank Customers
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[Primary Bank Segment] = "Likely Primary Bank"))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer snapshot rule count; no future prediction.

name: Demo High Value Low Engagement Customers
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[High Value Low Engagement] = TRUE()))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer snapshot rule count; no future prediction.

name: Demo Payroll Opportunity Customers
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[Eligible For Payroll Campaign] = TRUE()))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer snapshot rule count; no future prediction.

name: Demo Cross-Sell Opportunity Customers
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[Cross Sell Opportunity] = TRUE()))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer snapshot rule count; no future prediction.

name: Demo High Engagement Low Product Depth Customers
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[High Engagement Low Product Depth] = TRUE()))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer snapshot rule count; no future prediction.

name: Demo Salary Domiciliation Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Customers with Payroll], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Snapshot percentage across selected customers.

name: Demo Likely Primary Bank %
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Likely Primary Bank Customers], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Snapshot percentage across selected customers.

name: Demo Average Products per Customer
expression: AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Active Product Count])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. All-domain customer snapshot average; date slicers do not change the stock.

name: Demo Average Engagement Score
expression: AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Engagement Score])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. All-domain customer snapshot average; date slicers do not change the stock.

name: Demo Average Primary Bank Score
expression: AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Primary Bank Score])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. All-domain customer snapshot average; date slicers do not change the stock.

name: Demo Average Payroll Amount
expression: CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Monthly Payroll Amount]), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[Has Salary Domiciliation]=TRUE()))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Snapshot monthly payroll among customers with domiciliation; no annual-salary inference.

name: Demo Customers with 2+ Products
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[Active Product Count]>=2))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Active stock product count at the simulation endpoint.

name: Demo Customers with 3+ Products
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Customers], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Customer 360'[Active Product Count]>=3))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Active stock product count at the simulation endpoint.

name: Demo Cross-Sell Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Customers with 2+ Products], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Defined as customers with at least two active products / all demo customers; distinct from the opportunity flag.

name: Demo Active Product Customers
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Product Holdings'[Customer Key]), 'Demo Product Holdings'[Is Active]=TRUE(), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Selected product holders at endpoint; product/customer filters apply, dates are cleared.

name: Demo Product Penetration Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Active Product Customers], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Active holders of selected product / all master customers, assumed eligible for demo product analysis.

name: Demo New Payroll Customers
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Payroll'[Customer Key]), 'Demo Payroll'[Has Salary Domiciliation]=TRUE(), USERELATIONSHIP('Demo Payroll'[Payroll Start Date Key], 'Demo Date'[Date Key])),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customers whose modeled payroll start falls in selected dates; not net growth.

name: Demo Campaigns Sent
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Campaign Interactions'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Campaign Interactions'[Sent]=TRUE())),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer-campaign contacts, not distinct campaign definitions. Date refers to send date.

name: Demo Campaign Opens
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Campaign Interactions'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Campaign Interactions'[Opened]=TRUE())),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer-campaign contacts, not distinct campaign definitions. Date refers to send date.

name: Demo Campaign Clicks
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Campaign Interactions'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Campaign Interactions'[Clicked]=TRUE())),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer-campaign contacts, not distinct campaign definitions. Date refers to send date.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Campaign Interactions'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Campaign Interactions'[Converted]=TRUE())),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer-campaign contacts, not distinct campaign definitions. Date refers to send date.

name: Demo Campaign Cost
expression: SUM('Demo Campaign Interactions'[Campaign Cost])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Synthetic contact costs only; no ROI or revenue.

name: Demo Open Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Campaign Opens], [Demo Campaigns Sent])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Sent-based funnel rate; a conversion is a modeled campaign CTA completion, not causal incremental adoption.

name: Demo CTR
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Campaign Clicks], [Demo Campaigns Sent])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Sent-based funnel rate; a conversion is a modeled campaign CTA completion, not causal incremental adoption.

name: Demo Conversion Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Campaign Conversions], [Demo Campaigns Sent])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Sent-based funnel rate; a conversion is a modeled campaign CTA completion, not causal incremental adoption.

name: Demo Cost per Conversion
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Campaign Cost], [Demo Campaign Conversions])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Sent-based funnel rate; a conversion is a modeled campaign CTA completion, not causal incremental adoption.

name: Demo Digital Events
expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS('Demo Digital Events'),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Events within selected dates, including modeled service activations.

name: Demo Digital Sessions
expression: COALESCE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Digital Events'[Session Id]),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Distinct synthetic sessions within selected dates.

name: Demo Digital Active Customers
expression: COALESCE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Digital Events'[Customer Key]),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Distinct customers with any qualifying event in selected dates.

name: Demo Average Sessions per Customer
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Digital Sessions], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Selected-period numerator / full selected master cohort, including inactive customers.

name: Demo Average Events per Customer
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Digital Events], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Selected-period numerator / full selected master cohort, including inactive customers.

name: Demo Digital Engagement Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Digital Active Customers], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Selected-period numerator / full selected master cohort, including inactive customers.

name: Demo Mobile App Customers
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Digital Events'[Customer Key]), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Digital Events'[Channel]="Mobile App")),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customers with at least one app event in selected dates.

name: Demo Mobile App Adoption Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Mobile App Customers], [Demo Customers])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Selected-period app activity / selected master cohort; not installed-app count.

name: Demo Weekly Active Customers
expression:
VAR EndDate=MAX('Demo Date'[Date])
VAR StartDate=EndDate-6
VAR FirstAvailable=MINX(ALL('Demo Date'),'Demo Date'[Date])
RETURN IF(StartDate>=FirstAvailable, CALCULATE([Demo Digital Active Customers], REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Demo Date'[Date],StartDate,EndDate)))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Rolling 7 days ending at latest selected date. Blank when full lookback is unavailable.

name: Demo Active Customers 30D
expression:
VAR EndDate=MAX('Demo Date'[Date])
VAR StartDate=EndDate-29
VAR FirstAvailable=MINX(ALL('Demo Date'),'Demo Date'[Date])
RETURN IF(StartDate>=FirstAvailable, CALCULATE([Demo Digital Active Customers], REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Demo Date'[Date],StartDate,EndDate)))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Rolling 30 days ending at latest selected date. Blank when full lookback is unavailable.

name: Demo Active Customers 90D
expression:
VAR EndDate=MAX('Demo Date'[Date])
VAR StartDate=EndDate-89
VAR FirstAvailable=MINX(ALL('Demo Date'),'Demo Date'[Date])
RETURN IF(StartDate>=FirstAvailable, CALCULATE([Demo Digital Active Customers], REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Demo Date'[Date],StartDate,EndDate)))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Rolling 90 days ending at latest selected date. Blank when full lookback is unavailable.

name: Demo Monthly Active Customers
expression:
VAR EndDate=MAX('Demo Date'[Date])
RETURN CALCULATE([Demo Digital Active Customers],REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date'),DATESBETWEEN('Demo Date'[Date],DATE(YEAR(EndDate),MONTH(EndDate),1),EndDate))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Distinct active customers in month-to-date of latest selected date; month charts evaluate each month.

name: Demo Inactive Customers 30D
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Demo Active Customers 30D]),[Demo Customers]-[Demo Active Customers 30D])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Selected master cohort minus rolling-30-day active customers.

name: Demo Eligible Service Relationships
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Service Adoption'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Eligible]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Endpoint customer-service relationships. Additive across services; not a distinct customer count.

name: Demo Offered Service Relationships
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Service Adoption'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Offered]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Endpoint customer-service relationships. Additive across services; not a distinct customer count.

name: Demo Activated Service Relationships
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Service Adoption'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Activated]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Endpoint customer-service relationships. Additive across services; not a distinct customer count.

name: Demo Active Service Relationships
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Demo Service Adoption'), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Active Status]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Endpoint customer-service relationships. Additive across services; not a distinct customer count.

name: Demo Eligible Service Customers
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Service Adoption'[Customer Key]), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Eligible]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Distinct selected customers with at least one selected service in this endpoint state.

name: Demo Offered Service Customers
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Service Adoption'[Customer Key]), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Offered]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Distinct selected customers with at least one selected service in this endpoint state.

name: Demo Activated Service Customers
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Service Adoption'[Customer Key]), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Activated]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Distinct selected customers with at least one selected service in this endpoint state.

name: Demo Active Service Customers
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Demo Service Adoption'[Customer Key]), KEEPFILTERS('Demo Service Adoption'[Active Status]=TRUE()), REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Distinct selected customers with at least one selected service in this endpoint state.

name: Demo Service Activation Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Activated Service Relationships], [Demo Offered Service Relationships])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Activated / offered customer-service relationships at endpoint.

name: Demo Service Adoption Rate
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Activated Service Relationships], [Demo Eligible Service Relationships])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Activated / eligible customer-service relationships at endpoint.

name: Demo Average Service Usage
expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM('Demo Service Adoption'[Monthly Usage Count]),REMOVEFILTERS('Demo Date')), [Demo Active Service Relationships])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Last snapshot-month modeled uses / active customer-service relationships.

name: Demo Survey Responses
expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS('Demo Satisfaction'),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Survey responses in selected dates; repeat respondents may appear.

name: Demo Promoters
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE([Demo Survey Responses], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Satisfaction'[Nps Score]>=9)),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Response count using standard score classification.

name: Demo Detractors
expression: COALESCE(CALCULATE([Demo Survey Responses], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Satisfaction'[Nps Score]<=6)),0)
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Response count using standard score classification.

name: Demo Passives
expression: [Demo Survey Responses]-[Demo Promoters]-[Demo Detractors]
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Responses scored seven or eight.

name: Demo Promoter %
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Promoters], [Demo Survey Responses])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Share of selected responses.

name: Demo Detractor %
expression: DIVIDE([Demo Detractors], [Demo Survey Responses])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Share of selected responses.

name: Demo NPS
expression: 100 * ([Demo Promoter %]-[Demo Detractor %])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Net Promoter Score in points from -100 to 100; response-weighted, not average raw score.

name: Demo Average NPS Score
expression: AVERAGE('Demo Satisfaction'[Nps Score])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Mean raw zero-to-ten response, distinct from NPS.

name: Demo Average Satisfaction
expression: AVERAGE('Demo Satisfaction'[Satisfaction Score])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Mean one-to-five score among responding customers.

name: Demo Resolution Rate
expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Demo Survey Responses], KEEPFILTERS('Demo Satisfaction'[Resolved]=TRUE())),[Demo Survey Responses])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Resolved responses / all selected survey responses; no case SLA claim.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions MTD
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Campaign Conversions], DATESMTD('Demo Date'[Date]))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Send-cohort conversions for selected period-to-date; YTD blank when Jan 1 history is unavailable.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions QTD
expression: CALCULATE([Demo Campaign Conversions], DATESQTD('Demo Date'[Date]))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Send-cohort conversions for selected period-to-date; YTD blank when Jan 1 history is unavailable.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions YTD
expression: IF(DATE(YEAR(MAX('Demo Date'[Date])),1,1)>=MINX(ALL('Demo Date'),'Demo Date'[Date]),CALCULATE([Demo Campaign Conversions], DATESYTD('Demo Date'[Date])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Send-cohort conversions for selected period-to-date; YTD blank when Jan 1 history is unavailable.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions Previous Month
expression:
VAR BeginDate=MIN('Demo Date'[Date]) VAR FirstAvailable=MINX(ALL('Demo Date'),'Demo Date'[Date])
RETURN IF(EDATE(BeginDate,-1)>=FirstAvailable,CALCULATE([Demo Campaign Conversions],DATEADD('Demo Date'[Date],-1,MONTH)))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Exact selected-date set shifted to prior period; blank without full comparison history.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions Previous Year
expression:
VAR BeginDate=MIN('Demo Date'[Date]) VAR FirstAvailable=MINX(ALL('Demo Date'),'Demo Date'[Date])
RETURN IF(EDATE(BeginDate,-12)>=FirstAvailable,CALCULATE([Demo Campaign Conversions],DATEADD('Demo Date'[Date],-1,YEAR)))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Exact selected-date set shifted to prior period; blank without full comparison history.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions MoM Change
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Demo Campaign Conversions Previous Month]),[Demo Campaign Conversions]-[Demo Campaign Conversions Previous Month])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Absolute change against shifted previous month.

name: Demo Campaign Conversions YoY Change
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Demo Campaign Conversions Previous Year]),[Demo Campaign Conversions]-[Demo Campaign Conversions Previous Year])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Absolute change against shifted previous year.

name: Demo Engagement Balance
expression: SUM('Demo Customer 360'[Balance])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Original observed balance of selected demo opportunity cohort; grouping signals are synthetic. Currency unverified.

name: Demo Detail Product Depth
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Active Product Count]),TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer detail bridge from original customer ID; blank unless one customer is selected.

name: Demo Detail Payroll Amount
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Monthly Payroll Amount]),TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer detail bridge from original customer ID; blank unless one customer is selected.

name: Demo Detail Engagement
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Engagement Score]),TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer detail bridge from original customer ID; blank unless one customer is selected.

name: Demo Detail Primary Score
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Primary Bank Score]),TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer detail bridge from original customer ID; blank unless one customer is selected.

name: Demo Detail Active Services
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Services Active]),TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer detail bridge from original customer ID; blank unless one customer is selected.

name: Demo Detail Campaign Conversions
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Campaigns Converted]),TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer detail bridge from original customer ID; blank unless one customer is selected.

name: Demo Detail Latest NPS Score
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Demo Customer 360'[Nps Score]),TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key])))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer detail bridge from original customer ID; blank unless one customer is selected.

name: Demo Detail Opportunity Flags
expression:
VAR Linked=CALCULATETABLE('Demo Customer 360',TREATAS(VALUES('Dim Customer'[Customer Key]),'Demo Customer 360'[Customer Key]))
RETURN IF(HASONEVALUE('Dim Customer'[Customer ID]),CONCATENATEX(Linked,
IF('Demo Customer 360'[Eligible For Payroll Campaign],"Payroll; ","") & IF('Demo Customer 360'[Cross Sell Opportunity],"Cross-sell; ","") &
IF('Demo Customer 360'[High Value Low Engagement],"High value / low engagement; ","") & IF('Demo Customer 360'[Eligible For Travel Service],"Travel; ","") &
IF('Demo Customer 360'[Eligible For Fx Service],"FX; ","") & IF('Demo Customer 360'[Eligible For Tax Service],"Tax assistance; ","")))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Explainable flags, not a recommendation to contact without consent/suitability review.

name: Demo Campaign Funnel Value
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Demo Funnel Stage'[Sort Order]),1,[Demo Campaigns Sent],2,[Demo Campaign Opens],3,[Demo Campaign Clicks],4,[Demo Campaign Conversions])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Four-step sent/open/click/convert count.

name: Demo Service Funnel Value
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Demo Funnel Stage'[Sort Order]),1,[Demo Eligible Service Relationships],2,[Demo Offered Service Relationships],3,[Demo Activated Service Relationships],4,[Demo Active Service Relationships])
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Customer-service relationship funnel; distinct from customer counts.
